newsitem.title: UNITED NATIONS: U.N. chief to visit India, Geneva, Italy, Germany.
newsitem.headline: U.N. chief to visit India, Geneva, Italy, Germany.

text.p: Secretary-General Kofi Annan, who returns to New York later this week from an African tour, leaves next week for visits to India, Switzerland, Italy, the Vatican and Germany, a U.N. spokesman said on Monday.
Annan is due in New Delhi on April 5 to address foreign ministers of the 113-member Non-aligned Movement on April 7. His official visit to India ends on April 8.

Annan will be in Geneva from April 8 to 10 for meetings before paying an official visit to Italy from April 11 to 15. He inaugurates a U.N. staff college in Turin April 12 and has an audience with Pope John Paul II at the Vatican.
During an official visit to Germany from April 16 to 18 he will meet President Roman Herzog, Chancellor Helmut Kohl and Foreign Minister Klaus Kinkel.
